name: Stuibenfälle im Außerfern
kurzbeschreibung: The Stuibenfälle Waterfalls near Reutte and Breitenwang are dramatic tiered cascades of the Archbach river featuring suspension bridges, belvederes, and trails linking to Lake Plansee.
preis: Gorge paths and viewing platforms freely accessible; parking bays at powerhouse apply fees
oeffnungszeiten: Accessible year-round; caution required in winter and during icy conditions
beschreibung:
Überblick

The exhilarating Stuibenfälle Waterfalls in the Außerfern tumble through a precipitous limestone defile between Breitenwang near Reutte and the fjord-like basin of Lake Plansee. Channeled from the outflow of Lake Plansee, the roaring Archbach torrent surges through the craggy lower ramparts of the Ammergau Alps in a sequence of foaming white cascades. The local name 'Stuiben' derives from the dense plumes of aquatic mist ('dusting') that hang above the torrent, refracting brilliant rainbows in the morning sun. Over eons, rushing meltwaters have sculpted deep turquoise plunge pools, overhanging dolomite amphitheatres, and polished rock flutes. Skillfully modernized with safe timber walkways, cantilevered steel observation platforms, and an airy pedestrian suspension bridge spanning the gorge, the path unlocks thrilling bird's-eye views directly into the thundering vortex while highlighting the pioneering hydro-power heritage of the Reutte region.

Route & Anforderungen

The canyon excursion departs from the Breitenwang substation parking area (approx. 850 m) and ascends via the historic Ministersteig and Hermannsteig trails to the outlet of Lake Plansee (approx. 1 to 1.5 hours one way, 150 metres elevation gain). The path weaves across steel mesh footbridges, stone staircases, and gravel tracks flanking the rushing river. Traversing the airy suspension bridge directly above boiling rapids is a prime highlight. Supportive hiking shoes with gripping tread are strongly advised, as waterfall mist keeps steps damp. The route is highly recommended for sure-footed children (entirely inaccessible for strollers or wheelchairs due to rock staircases).

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via highway B179 to Reutte, continuing through Breitenwang toward Plansee to the designated hikers' parking lots at the municipal power utility. Train passengers disembark at Reutte in Tirol station and reach the canyon trailhead via a gentle 30-minute walk or local bus.

Tipps

Extend your walk past the upper falls directly to the shoreline of Lake Plansee. Relaxing at the lakeshore gazing into turquoise fjord waters after climbing the roaring gorge is an quintessential Außerfern mountain experience.
saison: Mai bis Oktober (im Winter vereist und gesperrt)
